entries.description: Registered S2 via start_session (claude/anthropic/claude-opus-5/high). Preload read: constitution, project-guidance, lessons-learned, CLAUDE.md. All three DABBLER_* keys present. No decision-review-queue entries.

Step 3.5: routed analysis (analysis, excl. anthropic -> gemini-pro, $0.0168) written to s2-ai-assignment-analysis.json; S2 block appended to ai-assignment.md. Adopted the analyst's missing step (a desk check) with a narrowed shape so it cannot be mistaken for S3's acceptance walk; departed on step-2 authoring (route the prose, bind the literals mechanically) and on next-orchestrator effort. Recorded two scope corrections: the spec's step-5 inbound-link list undercounts, and Set 106's 'committed literal gate' is run by no CI or test.

Relocated docs/tutorials/hello-world.md -> adopt-dabbler.md and docs/tutorials/video/ -> adopt-dabbler-video/ (git mv, history preserved). Repaired the relocated document's framing: retitled, added a 'Start here? No' pointer to the new first run, repointed the video link, and added the one labelled note that it still carries the team workflow. Repointed all 8 scene scripts + the video README at adopt-dabbler.md, and stated in the README that Hello World's own scene is deferred.

Authored the new docs/tutorials/hello-world.md (144 lines, 4 steps). Prose routed (documentation, excl. anthropic -> gemini-pro, $0.0361, draft saved raw as s2-hello-world-draft.json); every literal then bound by the orchestrator from bundle.json and the shipped string constants rather than derived by the model. Desk-walked the real sample end to end on the PyPI-published router 0.34.0 first, so the document describes observed behavior: s2-desk-check.md.

Repaired every inbound link. SCOPE CORRECTION: the spec's step 5 said the shipped getting-started.md.template needed no change because the new doc keeps the old filename -- that confirmation FAILED, because both shipped templates describe the ADOPTION content by name, so a resolving link is not the test. Repointed getting-started.md.template and monorepo-ci.yml.template at adopt-dabbler.md, rebuilt dist/, regenerated both cold-start goldens (UPDATE_GOLDEN=1). Also repaired 4 sites the spec did not name: the module-team-hello-world.md tombstone, release-and-recovery.md, README.md and quick-start.md. Folded into the staged, unpublished 0.47.0 -- no new bump.

Step 6 run as BOTH a mechanical overlap scan and a routed semantic review (analysis, excl. anthropic -> gemini-pro, $0.0232) -- a grep finds repeated strings, the ownership table is about repeated procedures, which paraphrase. Every cross-document string is shared UI vocabulary, not procedure. The routed pass returned 2 Majors; both adjudicated to Minor on consequence with reasons recorded in s2-duplicate-procedure-adjudication.md. Finding 2 is a real defect in the SPEC's ownership table (it assigns 'custom hosts' to release-and-recovery.md, which has no host content) -- escalated to Step 9 rather than fixed, since the spec's config is immutable at runtime. No document changed as a result.

SCOPE CORRECTION: Set 106's 'committed literal gate' (s3-check-literals.py) is referenced by no CI job, no pytest test and no npm script -- an artifact, not a gate. Authored its successor at repo level: ai_router/scripts/tutorial_gate.py (6 checks: command titles resolve, program output/test count/sample literals bound to bundle.json, relative links resolve, and the first-run negative constraint), ai_router/tests/test_tutorial_gate.py (34 tests), and a CI step beside drift_guard. FALSIFIED before trusting: 11 synthetic defects, all 11 fired. That falsification caught a real weakness -- the missingFunction presence check was satisfied by the slug 001-add-a-shout containing 'shout', the same coincidence-satisfies-presence-check class S1's third-provider opinion found; fixed with a standalone-token rule. The 106 script is left working and uninvalidated.

Suites green. pytest 3100 passed / 6 skipped (was 3066/6 at S1 close; delta is exactly the 34 new gate tests). Extension unit 1821 passing. npx tsc --noEmit clean. drift_guard OK. tutorial_gate OK. Layer 3 not run locally -- known-broken harness on this box (S1 environment residual); this session touched no Explorer-rendering surface, state-file writer or fixture harness, so L-064-12's trigger does not fire and CI is the signal.

Three phased rounds, anthropic excluded by construction. Round 1 discovery fan-out 2/2 (gpt-5-6 x2, $0.5246) -> ISSUES_FOUND, 4 blocking that de-duplicate to 2 real defects, both found independently by BOTH calls. Round 2 supplementary BEFORE remediation ($0.1956) -> 1 more blocking: git was an undeclared prerequisite, a true-cold-start miss. Round 3 remediation-review ($0.1064) -> VERIFIED, 0 findings, 2 fixes accepted + 1 accepted-with-modification, 2 Minors. Three distinct blockers total, all accepted, none disputed. Sidecar: s2-remediation-round-3.md. Round 3's 2 Minors were fixed post-verdict and NOT re-verified by a routed round -- one was a real contradiction (an agent 'already signed in to' vs 'you do not need an account anywhere'); the other asked the YAML detector to catch single-line blocks, which flagged the real document's own fences, so it was half-taken with negative tests recording the declined half.

Final suite on the finished tree: pytest 3133 passed / 6 skipped (delta from S1's 3066 is exactly the 67 gate tests). Extension unit 1821 passing; tsc clean; drift_guard OK; tutorial_gate OK. disposition.json authored; committing and pushing, then close_session.

Close attempt 1 FAILED the verification_backstop gate (round 4, $0.2658): the tutorial gate was materially fail-open, and would not have caught this session's own Windows-only step 4. Accepted 4 of 5 points, held the settled duplicate-procedure adjudication with reasons. Round 5 (remediation-review cycle 2, $0.1700) then REJECTED two of those fixes and was right twice more: commented YAML defeated the untagged detector, and the platform check used sets so the duplicated '-m unittest' masked the very regression it was written for. Both fixed (YAML furniture-skipping; Counter multiplicities) with the regression test round 5 specified. Gate tests 34 -> 77. Sidecars: s2-remediation-round-5.md, s2-remediation-round-6.md. Remediation-review bound now SPENT -- no further discretionary rounds; the close backstop adjudicates.
Final suite: pytest 3143 passed / 6 skipped (delta from S1's 3066 is exactly the 77 gate tests). tutorial_gate OK, drift_guard OK.

close_session SUCCEEDED on the third attempt. Backstop round 7 (gpt-5-6, anthropic excluded, $0.3283) returned VERIFIED against the pushed diff; all six gates PASS. Seven verification rounds total: discovery fan-out 2/2, supplementary, remediation-review x2, and three close-backstop rounds. Both loop bounds spent. Session 2 CLOSED VERIFIED.

Registered S3 via start_session (claude/anthropic/claude-opus-5/high). Preload read: constitution, project-guidance, lessons-learned, CLAUDE.md. All three DABBLER_* keys present. No decision-review-queue. Active set resolved from session-state.json status across all 107 sets.

Pre-walk automation floor: pytest 3149 passed / 6 skipped; tutorial_gate.py OK; released 0.47.0 diffed against HEAD (only two consumer-bootstrap templates differ, neither on the walk path) so the Marketplace build is walk-valid. Routed step-3.5 analysis (gemini-pro, anthropic excluded, $0.019) saved as s3-ai-assignment-analysis.json. UAT checklist authored: routed draft (documentation, gemini-pro, $0.029) then every product literal re-bound from sampleProject.ts + trySampleProject.ts + bundle.json by a builder script; the binding caught the routed draft's wrong progress-stage labels and a wrong new-window claim.

Layer 3 investigated: 28/28 specs fail locally at Electron launch (before any assertion). Ruled out by experiment: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE pollution (harness allowlist already defends; probe with scrubbed env fails identically), VS Code version (1.124.2 fails same), the sandboxed shell, and a stale bundle. CI green on this session's commit 7112b8c across macos/ubuntu/windows. Remaining unproven hypothesis: local Node 25.8.1 vs CI's pinned Node 20; no nvm available to falsify. Recorded in s3-pre-walk-floor.md; follow-on named, out of scope here.
